hypotheses.B0_batch_packing_is_stable: The 95th percentile absolute batched-versus-serial fidelity discrepancy is at most 0.05 for every method and cell.
hypotheses.B1_midpoint_beats_base_activity_clustere: The pair-bootstrap 95% interval for correct-midpoint minus base-activity fidelity is above zero in every cell.
hypotheses.B2_midpoint_is_target_specific: Correct-midpoint exceeds wrong-target-midpoint fidelity by at least 0.30 in every cell.
hypotheses.B3_midpoint_support_is_target_specific: Correct-midpoint support Jaccard exceeds wrong-target-midpoint Jaccard by at least 0.30 in every cell.
hypotheses.B4_midpoint_nearly_matches_realized_orac: Correct-midpoint retains at least 85% of realized-local fidelity in every cell.
hypotheses.B5_base_tangent_specificity_is_positive_: The pair-bootstrap 95% interval for correct-base-tangent minus wrong-base-tangent is above zero in every cell, while the median advantage remains below 0.10.
